Presenting the full video song "Duniya" from the Bollywood movie 'Dev D' featuring Abhay Deol, Mahi Gill, Kalki Koechlin. The song is sung by Amit Trivedi and also the music is composed by Amit Trivedi. The lyrics are written by Amitabh Bhattacharya.
Song- Duniya
Film - Dev D
Artist- Abhay Deol, Mahi Gill, Kalki Koechlin
Singer - Amit Trivedi
Music Director- Amit Trivedi
Lyricist - Amitabh Bhattacharya
Music On - T Series
